julia-peopleops: Hey team — Alek (new manager on Platform) starts Monday. I put together a compact Week 0 agenda + a high-level 30/60/90. Can folks confirm owners for access + any blockers? :wave:

emma-hr: Thanks Julia. Sharing checklist snippet below. I can own HR intro and benefits. Can someone from IT confirm laptop + Okta onboarding?

emma-hr: ```
Week 0 (first 3 days):
- Day 0 (prestart): welcome email, org chart, access request submitted
- Day 1: HR intro (benefits, payroll), manager 1:1 w/ Priya, team intro
- Day 2: tooling access (Slack, Okta, Notion), infra walkthrough
- Day 3: 1:1s + setup errands

30/60/90 (sketch):
- 30d: ramp, read docs, ship small infra change
- 60d: own a feature, run a postmortem
- 90d: lead roadmap proposal
``` :white_check_mark:

devon-it: @julia-peopleops @emma-hr IT note: I've got a pending imaging slot for a MacBook Pro. Okta invite normally goes out within 1 hour of account create, but sometimes require manual SCIM sync. If you need faster, ping me and I'll do a manual invite.

michael-manager: I'll take the team intro + first-week shadow schedule. Can someone assign workspace access to the 'platform-managers' group? I can't see it in Notion.

julia-peopleops: thx @michael-manager — @devon-it can you add 'platform-managers' to the Notion workspace? Also Alex from Security needs to run a quick IAM review for manager privileges.

devon-it: On it. Notion group added. For SCIM: command I ran last time:
```
# sync users
oktactl sync --org redwood --force
```
I'll post when laptop is imaged. ETA: EOD Friday.

alek-new-hire: Thanks everyone! Quick Q: who do I ping for repo access (private infra repos)?

michael-manager: Ping me and @alex-security. I'll approve the access request once IT creates the PR reviewer group.

alex-security: I'll review the IAM policy, should be quick. FYI we'll require 2FA and hardware key for elevated perms :lock:

onboard-bot: Reminder: New hire checklist created: https://redwood.notion.site/Onboarding-Template (automated)

emma-hr: One more: schedule a benefits enrollment call within first 14 days. I've blocked 30 mins for Alek on Tue 10am.

julia-peopleops: Perfect. Action items:
- emma-hr: HR intro & benefits call
- devon-it: image laptop + Okta sync (ETA EOD Fri)
- michael-manager: team intro + repo ownership
- alex-security: IAM review
- julia-peopleops: follow-up with infra docs + sample 30/60/90 template

Anyone want to add anything else or identify blockers? :eyes:

devon-it: small blocker: VPN cert provisioning sometimes needs approval from cloud-admins. I'll start that flow now.

michael-manager: No blockers from my side. excited to onboard Alek :tada:

alek-new-hire: Appreciate it — looking forward to Monday! :smile:
